summary: Backend + frontend testing of teacher product Phase (i) Teacher Home and Phase (ii) merged Create-Assignment. Wrote pytest suite (8 tests, all pass) covering assignment listing shape, student join by code + counter increment, teacher-configs -> activate -> create-session linkage, per-assignment sessions endpoint, validation error path, and regression for legacy /api/sessions + /api/sessions/{id}/interact. Ran a Playwright flow across ?teacher and ?config: header create CTA, card status/title/join-code/copy-code, empty-required validation surfaces validation-error (no success screen), full create path renders assignment-created with created-join-code + created-go-home + created-create-another, does NOT auto-launch a student writing session, and created-go-home returns to ?teacher with the new card in the grid. Everything works. One minor invalid-HTML issue found: assignment card renders a <button> inside a <button>.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid HTML: <button data-testid='assignment-card-{CODE}'> (motion.button) has a nested <button data-testid='copy-code-{CODE}'> inside it. React logs a hydration warning ('In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>'). Functionally the copy button still works because of e.stopPropagation, but this is invalid a11y/HTML and will show up in every render.

action_items: (Optional / low) Refactor AssignmentCard so it is a <div role='button' tabIndex=0 onClick=...> or an <a>, not a <button>, so the CopyCode <button> child is valid HTML and the React hydration warning goes away.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_assignment_summary` treats a session as 'active' if it has any interactions/turns. Sessions created by the join-by-code path start empty, so student_count increments but active_count stays 0 until the student writes something. That is consistent with the spec ('student/active counts') but worth being aware of when reading counters in tests.

server.py `create_session_from_config` uses `Optional[CreateSessionFromConfig] = None` and then reads `payload.student_name`; because the payload is required=false, an empty body still yields a defaulted model — works correctly.

TeacherConfig.jsx activate() surfaces server 422 detail into the same `validation-result` box used by client validation — good; test verified errors render as `validation-error` and no success screen appears.
TeacherHome.jsx AssignmentCard nests a <button> inside a <button> (see frontend_issues) — invalid HTML.
test_credentials: None required (single implicit local teacher, teacher_id='local-teacher').
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed configurations/sessions (TEST_Argue social media, TEST_UI Position Paper, TEST_Regression short, students named TEST_Student, TEST_ListSessionsStudent, Ada). Not cleaned up — teacher assignment count will grow on repeated runs; that is fine because tests query by id, not by count.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_teacher_assignments.py is idempotent (each run creates its own config and asserts by id). Use it as regression for the teacher product. Frontend flow uses ?teacher and ?config query params on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Nested-button HTML issue is the only outstanding item and it is cosmetic; do NOT block on it.
